instruction.name: vilvh.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, interleave the 64-bit elements in the upper half of that lane from `a` and `b`: the element from `b` is placed at the even output position and the element from `a` at the following odd position.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vilvh.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vilvh.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vilvh.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vilvh.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vilvh.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vilvh.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vilvh.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vilvh.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
